aspects.reason: Planned focused test coverage for the same-plan recovery classifier around review/test exhaustion, current-plan blocking issue targeting, and manual/human-review gate exclusion.
Planned human-review gate handling so same-plan recovery is not classified while any manual or human-review gate is present.
Planned explicit manual-gate exclusion in the review/test verdict exhaustion decision.
Planned review-cycle decision behavior for only classifying same-plan recovery when all remaining blockers target the running plan.
Planned real-code Vitest coverage aligned with the shared CI and guardrails findings.
Planned bounded same-plan recovery budget semantics and fail-closed exhaustion behavior.
Planned a focused module that captures rejected issue outcomes from final verifier verdict data and includes them in the recovery fixer context.
Planned the same module to distinguish unresolved issue outcomes and render them alongside rejected outcomes in recovery fixer context.
Planned mandatory post-recovery re-run of blocking checks before build execution resumes.
Planned a safety bypass classifier that treats cross-plan issue signals as ineligible for same-plan recovery and routes them to the fallback path.
Planned preservation of the existing build:terminal-failure envelope path, aligned with the materialized client terminal-failure schema tests.
Planned same-plan recovery eligibility checks that consume compile/queue preflight outcomes and bypass unsafe preflight failures.
Planned routing of bypassed cases through the existing recovery sidecar path, preserving the typed read API and sidecar rendering flow.
Planned upstream issue signals as explicit recovery-bypass reasons so upstream-caused failures keep terminal/sidecar handling.
Planned dirty/unsafe worktree detection as a hard bypass, using the validation dirty worktree evidence path as the concrete integration point.
Planned new real-code Vitest coverage plus CI validation for the projection distinction.
Planned Console UI rendering updates so same-plan recovery attempts receive distinct visible labels/badges from normal repair rounds.
Planned review-cycle projection/model handling to preserve normal review repair rounds separately from same-plan recovery attempts.
Planned run-state/use-run-detail projection changes to carry and expose recovery-attempt semantics.
Planned targeted tests for run-state selectors/hooks and Console review/run rendering.
Planned a focused test-authoring module for AC-008 cross-plan/upstream recovery refusal coverage.
The module requires a refusal scenario where recovery is rejected for work classified outside the failed plan.
The module is explicitly test work and follows the shared real-code Vitest guidance.
The module covers upstream refusal when the classifier exposes that category, without inventing unsupported classifier states.
